subject.title: feat(lobster): in-process LLM adapters for embedded runner (#90909)

question: Should embedded Lobster expose this bridge as provider `openclaw`, use a distinct embedded provider id, or route through the existing `llm-task` policy surface before exposing it?
rationale: The PR changes provider routing and credential boundaries for embedded workflows, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security contract safely.

options.title: Repair bridge before merge
options.body: Keep the bridge direction but require final-env credential masking, `llm-task` policy preservation, provider-name approval, docs updates, and live proof before landing.

options.title: Approve a distinct embedded contract
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally keep a different adapter policy or provider id, but should document the behavior and compatibility expectations before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the design issue
options.body: Keep the canonical issue as the design thread and leave this branch unmerged until provider naming and security policy are settled.

recommendation.title: Repair bridge before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the bridge direction but require final-env credential masking, `llm-task` policy preservation, provider-name approval, docs updates, and live proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the `llm-task` merge and recent Lobster/llm-task maintenance, making them a good routing owner for the provider-policy decision.
